name: Postie Bike
summary: Split both cream tank inserts on their actual finished facet diagonals; removed the spikes that escaped the red shell in the hero view. Reduced the crankcase casting, opened cooling fins, tapered shorts and shins, joined the neck to the collar/shell and removed a floating black helmet disc. Added collar/vest creases. Thin open wire spokes retain wheel daylight. Baked triangles 2611 / 899 / 599; unchanged physics/sidecar. Global silhouette scores 0.8492 / 0.8256 / 0.7944 remain below ~.95; review candidate with remaining shaded mismatches documented. Coarse tyres now retain twelve outer stations. The low-tier helmet now uses eight circumferential segments and four latitude bands; merged pannier masses and lean frame tubes funded the broad form.
feedback: Comment on this page (what to change, which view or state); the session turns each comment into a bug bead that cites this page and the car's id.
